ValidationRule.description: This Validation Rule was configured to prevent AM from editing a Quote once a Quote is submitted for Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'API Only profile', NOT(ISCHANGED( PMC_CPQ_FlowVRByPassToggle__c )), AND( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( ApprovalStatus__c ) , 'Pending') ,ISPICKVAL( ApprovalStatus__c , 'Pending') ) ,
NOT(ISCHANGED(SubmittedUser__c)), NOT(ISCHANGED(SubmittedDate__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You may not edit a Quote once it has been submitted for approval. If you wish to make any changes, click the 'Recall Approvals' button
